name: PyPantograph
author: stanford-centaur
one_liner: Python interface to Lean 4 for running tactics step by step and checking a whole file matches its specification.

loop.proposes: Tactics and proof attempts from a prover model
loop.judged_by: Lean, driven step by step, plus a whole-file conformity check (check_track)
loop.steers: Resulting goals and errors feed the search for the next tactic

not_proved: A passing check shows the proof fits the stated Lean specification. It does not show the specification itself is the right one.
